notes: Created implementation plan for expander icon and positions change request. Plan covers 3 phases: (1) Desktop floating edge icons with icon logic fix for left sidebar, (2) Mobile FAB replacing hamburger menu with dynamic chevron, (3) Accessibility and polish. Included 40+ Given-When-Then scenarios across user behavior, component behavior, and E2E levels. World-review informed decisions: no floating toggles for mobile sidebars, FAB at bottom-right to avoid bottom sheet handle conflict, FAB icon flips to downward chevron when sheet is open. Key bug fix: left sidebar toggle icon logic is inverted (chevron_right when open should be chevron_left).
